stem.text: Source S emits microwaves with a constant amplitude. The microwaves hit a metal screen P and are reflected. A stationary wave is formed between S and P. The wavelength of the microwaves is much smaller than the distance between S and P.

stem.alt: Diagram with a source labelled S on the left, a detector labelled Q with a right-pointing arrow in the middle, and a vertical metal screen labelled P on the right.

stem.text: A detector Q is moved at a slow, constant speed from S to P.
What happens to the amplitude of the signal detected by Q?
